settings.headline: The admissions calendar
settings.intro: Applying for fall 2027. Every step is arranged with the admissions office by phone or email; there is no application form on this site.

items.title: Visit
items.text: Come to an open morning or book a private tour. Grade 6–12 applicants can shadow a class.

items.title: Apply
items.text: The admissions office sends the application, teacher references and transcript request.

items.title: Meet
items.text: A conversation with a teacher, a reading and writing sample, and a playdate morning for Pre-K and K.

items.title: Financial aid
items.text: Families who want aid send the aid statement; awards are need-based.

items.title: Decisions
items.text: Decisions and aid awards are sent together.

items.title: Reply
items.text: Families reply by April 10 and are welcomed at the spring family evening.

settings.headline: Tuition and fees, 2026–27
settings.intro: Fictional figures for a fictional school. Lunch, books and day trips are included.
settings.foot: Financial aid is need-based and covers up to full tuition. No payment is taken on this site.

items.a: Siblings of current students are considered first in each grade, as long as the application is complete by January 15.
Two morning and two late bus routes run from the town center and the north villages.

items.q: Can my child visit for a day?
items.a: Yes, from Grade 6. The admissions office arranges a shadow day with a student guide.
About 14 in the Lower School, 15 in the Middle School and 13 at the Upper School oval tables.
